.github/workflows/contract-placement.yml.text:
name: contract-placement

# Work-only candidate, NOT REGISTERED / NOT INSTALLED.
# Same complete placement checks on the existing trusted Linux CI pool; no hosted fallback.
# Candidate PR code never runs on the controller secret-bearing principal.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal ]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  contract-placement:
    name: contract-placement
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true'
    runs-on: ["self-hosted","Linux","X64","clued","pool-general","trust-internal"]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        if: >-
          (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Require a qualified ordinary CI subject before candidate execution
        env:
          CLUED_AUTOMATION_SELF_HOSTED: ${{ needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          const e=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_PATH,'utf8'));
          const own=process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY==='tdoljyj/cross-memory-system' && e.repository?.full_name===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const trustedPush=process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME==='push' && process.env.GITHUB_REF==='refs/heads/main';
          const trustedPr=process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME==='pull_request' && e.pull_request?.base?.ref==='main' && e.pull_request?.head?.repo?.full_name===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY && (process.env.GITHUB_ACTOR===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER || process.env.CLUED_AUTOMATION_SELF_HOSTED==='true');
          if(!own || (!trustedPush && !trustedPr)){console.error('contract-placement: subject is not qualified for the persistent internal CI pool');process.exit(1);}
          NODE
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Placement and renderer fixtures
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest scripts/ci/test_check_contract_placement.py -v
          node --test apps/clued-cloud/tests/agent-contract-bootstrap.test.mjs
      - name: Build actual public bootstrap without the application dependency tree
        env:
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts esbuild@0.28.1
          node "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build/node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild" apps/clued-cloud/worker/continuity.ts \
            --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:js-tiktoken/* \
            --define:__CLUED_BUILD_SHA__="\"$CANDIDATE\"" --outfile="$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs"
      - name: Render all actual and synthetic contract parts
        run: node apps/clued-cloud/scripts/render-agent-contract-budget.mjs --worker-module "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"
      - name: Enforce placement and one-time production gate
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_contract_placement.py --base "$BASE" --head "$CANDIDATE" --minimum-service-version 0.4.5 --rendered-responses "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"

.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml.text:
name: gitleaks

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal ]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  gitleaks-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    timeout-minutes: 25
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))) && 'gitleaks' || 'gitleaks-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true')))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true
      # Self-hosted workspaces persist between runs. Checkout neither prunes
      # remote-tracking refs of deleted branches nor removes the PR merge refs
      # (refs/remotes/pull/*) that earlier runs of other PRs left behind, so
      # closed or superseded history stayed in the scan. Scan exactly the
      # remote's branches and tags plus this run's checked-out HEAD.
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Drop refs of deleted branches and of other PRs' earlier runs
        run: |
          git remote prune origin
          git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/pull |
            while read -r ref; do git update-ref -d "$ref"; done
      - name: Validate exact historical exceptions and detection regressions
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py \
            --config .gitleaks.toml \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-reviewed.ignore" \
            --self-test
      - name: Scan complete history with Gitleaks 8.30.1
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v "$PWD:/repo" \
            -v "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-reviewed.ignore:/reviewed.ignore:ro" \
            ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1@sha256:c00b6bd0aeb3071cbcb79009cb16a60dd9e0a7c60e2be9ab65d25e6bc8abbb7f \
            git /repo --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml \
            --gitleaks-ignore-path /reviewed.ignore --redact --exit-code 1

  gitleaks-untrusted-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    timeout-minutes: 25
    name: ${{ false && 'gitleaks' || 'gitleaks-hosted-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (false && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted != 'true' && (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository || github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true
      # Self-hosted workspaces persist between runs. Checkout neither prunes
      # remote-tracking refs of deleted branches nor removes the PR merge refs
      # (refs/remotes/pull/*) that earlier runs of other PRs left behind, so
      # closed or superseded history stayed in the scan. Scan exactly the
      # remote's branches and tags plus this run's checked-out HEAD.
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Drop refs of deleted branches and of other PRs' earlier runs
        run: |
          git remote prune origin
          git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/pull |
            while read -r ref; do git update-ref -d "$ref"; done
      - name: Validate exact historical exceptions and detection regressions
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py \
            --config .gitleaks.toml \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-reviewed.ignore" \
            --self-test
      - name: Scan complete history with Gitleaks 8.30.1
        run: |
          docker run --rm \
            -v "$PWD:/repo" \
            -v "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-reviewed.ignore:/reviewed.ignore:ro" \
            ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1@sha256:c00b6bd0aeb3071cbcb79009cb16a60dd9e0a7c60e2be9ab65d25e6bc8abbb7f \
            git /repo --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml \
            --gitleaks-ignore-path /reviewed.ignore --redact --exit-code 1

.github/workflows/trivy.yml.text:
name: trivy

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [ self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal ]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  trivy-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))) && 'trivy' || 'trivy-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true')))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Prepare persistent Trivy cache
        run: |
          TRIVY_CACHE_DIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/clued-trivy"
          mkdir -p "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR"
          echo "TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download vulnerability database through runner network
        timeout-minutes: 22
        env:
          TRIVY_IMAGE: ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9
          # When every download attempt fails, a cached database built within
          # this many hours is still used, with a warning. Older or missing
          # databases fail the job as before.
          TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS: "72"
        run: |
          # Only the pinned scanner and its cache use the runner network. No
          # checkout or Docker socket is mounted during this download. A host
          # loopback proxy is otherwise unreachable from the container bridge.
          db_dir="$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR/db"
          metadata_epoch() {
            value="$(sed -n "s/.*\"$1\" *: *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$db_dir/metadata.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
            if [ -n "$value" ]; then date -u -d "$value" +%s 2>/dev/null || true; fi
          }
          now="$(date -u +%s)"
          next_update="$(metadata_epoch NextUpdate)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$next_update" ] && [ "$now" -lt "$next_update" ]; then
            echo "Cached vulnerability database is current; no download needed."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Trivy deletes the cached metadata before it downloads, so a failed
          # in-place download destroys the last good database. Download into a
          # per-run staging cache and swap it in only after success. The cache
          # is root-owned by the container, so file operations run in it too.
          staging="trivy-db-staging-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          in_cache() {
            docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/cache" "$TRIVY_IMAGE" -ec "$1" sh "$staging"
          }
          # Also drop staging caches abandoned by cancelled runs.
          cleanup_staging() {
            in_cache 'rm -rf "/cache/$1"
              find /cache -maxdepth 1 -name "trivy-db-staging-*" -mmin +120 -exec rm -rf {} \;' || true
          }
          trap cleanup_staging EXIT

          downloaded=false
          for repository in ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-db:2 mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2; do
            for attempt in 1 2; do
            if docker run --rm --network host \
              -e HTTP_PROXY -e HTTPS_PROXY -e NO_PROXY \
              -e http_proxy -e https_proxy -e no_proxy \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
              "$TRIVY_IMAGE" \
              fs --download-db-only --timeout 5m --cache-dir "/root/.cache/trivy/$staging" --db-repository "$repository"; then
              downloaded=true
              break 2
            fi
            sleep "$attempt"
            done
          done
          if [ "$downloaded" = true ]; then
            in_cache 'rm -rf /cache/db.previous
              if [ -d /cache/db ]; then mv /cache/db /cache/db.previous; fi
              mv "/cache/$1/db" /cache/db
              rm -rf /cache/db.previous'
            exit 0
          fi

          updated_at="$(metadata_epoch UpdatedAt)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$updated_at" ]; then
            age_hours=$(( (now - updated_at) / 3600 ))
            if [ "$age_hours" -le "$TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS" ]; then
              echo "::warning title=Trivy DB download failed::Using the cached vulnerability database built ${age_hours}h ago (limit ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h)."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::Cached vulnerability database is ${age_hours}h old, over the ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h fallback limit."
          else
            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::No usable cached vulnerability database."
          fi
          exit 1
      - name: Vulnerabilities (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          # The previous step prepared the database; never re-download here.
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --skip-db-update --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Secrets
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Misconfiguration (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --checks-bundle-repository ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-checks:2 --scanners misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 /repo

  trivy-untrusted-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    name: ${{ false && 'trivy' || 'trivy-hosted-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (false && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted != 'true' && (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository || github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Vulnerabilities (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --db-repository ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-db:2 --db-repository mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2 --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Secrets
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Misconfiguration (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --checks-bundle-repository ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-checks:2 --scanners misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 /repo

.github/workflows/contract-placement.yml.text:
name: contract-placement

# Work-only candidate, NOT REGISTERED / NOT INSTALLED.
# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the same complete placement checks run on a GitHub-hosted
# runner (free minutes, $0 Actions budget cap) as an execution-only run. Its job name is not a required check
# name. contract-placement is never relayed: this job runs PR code, so App 5368905 always publishes the
# required contract-placement check from its formal local role, whatever this run concludes.
# Candidate PR code never runs on the controller secret-bearing principal.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
      # check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_SOURCE: independent-ci-native-work-admission
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS: "600"
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  contract-placement:
    name: contract-placement-hosted-executor
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        if: >-
          (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Require a qualified ordinary CI subject before candidate execution
        env:
          CLUED_AUTOMATION_SELF_HOSTED: ${{ needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import fs from 'node:fs';
          const e=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_PATH,'utf8'));
          const own=process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY==='tdoljyj/cross-memory-system' && e.repository?.full_name===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const trustedPush=process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME==='push' && process.env.GITHUB_REF==='refs/heads/main';
          const trustedPr=process.env.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME==='pull_request' && e.pull_request?.base?.ref==='main' && e.pull_request?.head?.repo?.full_name===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY && (process.env.GITHUB_ACTOR===process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER || process.env.CLUED_AUTOMATION_SELF_HOSTED==='true');
          if(!own || (!trustedPush && !trustedPr)){console.error('contract-placement: subject is not qualified for the persistent internal CI pool');process.exit(1);}
          NODE
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Placement and renderer fixtures
        run: |
          python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_check_contract_placement.py -v
          node --test apps/clued-cloud/tests/agent-contract-bootstrap.test.mjs
      - name: Build actual public bootstrap without the application dependency tree
        env:
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts esbuild@0.28.1
          node "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build/node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild" apps/clued-cloud/worker/continuity.ts \
            --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:js-tiktoken/* \
            --define:__CLUED_BUILD_SHA__="\"$CANDIDATE\"" --outfile="$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs"
      - name: Render all actual and synthetic contract parts
        run: node apps/clued-cloud/scripts/render-agent-contract-budget.mjs --worker-module "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"
      - name: Enforce placement and one-time production gate
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: python3 -I -B scripts/ci/check_contract_placement.py --base "$BASE" --head "$CANDIDATE" --minimum-service-version 0.4.5 --rendered-responses "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"
      - name: Emit relay identity
        run: |
          set -eu
          jwt="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=clued-hosted-relay-v1" \
            | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["value"])')"
          echo "::notice title=clued-hosted-relay-v1::$jwt"

.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml.text:
name: gitleaks

# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the scan runs on a GitHub-hosted runner with free
# minutes under the $0 Actions budget cap as an executor only. Its job name is not a required check
# name; App 5368905 publishes the required gitleaks check after it verifies this run's relay identity,
# and otherwise runs its formal local role.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
      # check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_SOURCE: independent-ci-native-work-admission
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS: "600"
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  gitleaks-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    timeout-minutes: 25
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))) && 'gitleaks-hosted-executor' || 'gitleaks-hosted-executor-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      # The trusted base only: the pinned .gitleaks.toml, the reviewed-finding helper and the
      # temporary-storage action come from main, never from the pull request.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Exactly the input of the local formal role (worker/formal-gitleaks-v4/required-history/
      # prepare.mjs): a fresh Git directory with no checkout, holding the fresh remote heads and tags,
      # the detached current head and the pinned reviewed commits (objects only, never refs), with
      # only the pinned .gitleaks.toml beside it. No .gitattributes, .gitleaksignore or other file of
      # the pull request is read: the scan sees history as data, with no attributes of any tree.
      - name: Prepare the required history
        env:
          FETCH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || '' }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          umask 022
          export LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
          scan="$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks"; repo="$scan/repo"; control="$scan/control"
          mkdir "$scan" "$repo" "$control"
          echo "cf631812810d997f42496af561f44930b51087737f146c4a7541c5dbc0a994cd  .gitleaks.toml" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          echo "433b24137a7d3430990b69e61c0b4ebcd9dad47d770c5df62d6e1fef28b7f7a9  scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          sed -n 's/^# clued-reviewed-finding: {"fingerprint":"\([0-9a-f]\{40\}\):.*$/\1/p' .gitleaks.toml | sort -u > "$control/reviewed-commits"
          echo "fcb2cc04ee35e01fbfc4bfc3dc9b0bb0ba78a6c4083ab5e17433c549450d59bb  $control/reviewed-commits" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          git init --quiet --template= "$repo"
          auth="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$FETCH_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)"
          fetch() {
            GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.https://github.com/.extraheader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="AUTHORIZATION: basic $auth" \
              git -C "$repo" -c core.logAllRefUpdates=false -c core.hooksPath=/nonexistent-clued-hooks -c protocol.allow=never \
              -c protocol.https.allow=always fetch --quiet --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules --no-auto-gc --update-head-ok \
              "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$@"
          }
          fetch '+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*' '+refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*'
          fetch "$HEAD_SHA" $(cat "$control/reviewed-commits")
          rm -f "$repo/.git/FETCH_HEAD"
          git -C "$repo" -c core.logAllRefUpdates=false update-ref --no-deref HEAD "$HEAD_SHA"
          test "$(git -C "$repo" cat-file -t "$HEAD_SHA")" = commit
          test -z "$BASE_SHA" || test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          test "$(git -C "$repo" cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype)' < "$control/reviewed-commits" | sort -u)" = commit
          test -z "$(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' | grep -Ev '^refs/(heads|tags)/' || true)"
          for indirect in shallow info/grafts objects/info/alternates objects/info/http-alternates logs; do test ! -e "$repo/.git/$indirect"; done
          git -C "$repo" fsck --full --strict --no-reflogs --no-progress
          install -m 0444 .gitleaks.toml "$repo/.gitleaks.toml"
          printf '[safe]\n\tdirectory = /repo\n\tdirectory = /test\n' > "$control/git-safe.config"
          chmod -R a+rX "$repo" && chmod 0444 "$control/git-safe.config"
      - name: Validate exact historical exceptions and detection regressions
        run: |
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py \
            --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks/repo/.gitleaks.toml" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks/control/reviewed.ignore" \
            --self-test
      # The local role's container (worker/verify-once/verify-worker.mjs createArguments) and argv
      # (prepare.mjs SCAN_ARGS), with the exact reviewed ignore file that its self-test accepts.
      - name: Scan complete history with Gitleaks 8.30.1
        run: |
          set -eu
          scan="$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks"
          image=ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1@sha256:c00b6bd0aeb3071cbcb79009cb16a60dd9e0a7c60e2be9ab65d25e6bc8abbb7f
          echo "d599f6b9733e68370f7353114600f9939d675202de828d68cc761f3153aa2abe  $scan/control/reviewed.ignore" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          chmod 0444 "$scan/control/reviewed.ignore"
          docker pull --quiet "$image" > /dev/null
          docker run --rm --pull=never --network=none --ipc=private --cgroupns=private --user=65532:65532 --read-only \
            --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit=128 --cpus=2 --memory=2147483648 \
            --memory-swap=2147483648 --ulimit=nofile=1024:1024 --env=NODE_OPTIONS= --env=NODE_PATH= --env=HOME=/scratch \
            --tmpfs=/scratch:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=536870912,mode=0700,uid=65532,gid=65532 \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/repo,dst=/repo,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/control/reviewed.ignore,dst=/reviewed.ignore,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/control/git-safe.config,dst=/etc/gitconfig,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --workdir=/repo --entrypoint /usr/bin/gitleaks "$image" \
            git /repo --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml --gitleaks-ignore-path /reviewed.ignore --redact --exit-code 1
      - name: Emit relay identity
        run: |
          set -eu
          jwt="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=clued-hosted-relay-v1" \
            | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["value"])')"
          echo "::notice title=clued-hosted-relay-v1::$jwt"

.github/workflows/trivy.yml.text:
name: trivy

# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the scans run on a GitHub-hosted runner with free
# minutes under the $0 Actions budget cap as an executor only. Its job name is not a required check
# name; App 5368905 publishes the required trivy check after it verifies this run's relay identity,
# and otherwise runs its formal local role.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
      # check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_SOURCE: independent-ci-native-work-admission
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS: "600"
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  trivy-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))) && 'trivy-hosted-executor' || 'trivy-hosted-executor-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # As the local workspace preparation (prepare-workspaces.py tree_modes_regular): only regular
      # blobs (100644/100755). A symlink (120000), submodule (160000) or any other tree entry could
      # point a scanner outside the checkout; such a tree is never scanned here, only locally.
      - name: Refuse symlinks, submodules and other non-regular tree entries
        run: |
          set -eu
          git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-trivy-tree"
          if tr '\0' '\n' < "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-trivy-tree" | grep -Ev '^(100644|100755) blob [0-9a-f]{40}[[:space:]]' | grep -q .; then
            echo "::error title=trivy-hosted-executor::the tree has a symlink, submodule or other non-regular entry"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Prepare persistent Trivy cache
        run: |
          TRIVY_CACHE_DIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/clued-trivy"
          mkdir -p "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR"
          echo "TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download vulnerability database through runner network
        timeout-minutes: 22
        env:
          TRIVY_IMAGE: ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9
          # When every download attempt fails, a cached database built within
          # this many hours is still used, with a warning. Older or missing
          # databases fail the job as before.
          TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS: "72"
        run: |
          # Only the pinned scanner and its cache use the runner network. No
          # checkout or Docker socket is mounted during this download. A host
          # loopback proxy is otherwise unreachable from the container bridge.
          db_dir="$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR/db"
          metadata_epoch() {
            value="$(sed -n "s/.*\"$1\" *: *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$db_dir/metadata.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
            if [ -n "$value" ]; then date -u -d "$value" +%s 2>/dev/null || true; fi
          }
          now="$(date -u +%s)"
          next_update="$(metadata_epoch NextUpdate)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$next_update" ] && [ "$now" -lt "$next_update" ]; then
            echo "Cached vulnerability database is current; no download needed."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Trivy deletes the cached metadata before it downloads, so a failed
          # in-place download destroys the last good database. Download into a
          # per-run staging cache and swap it in only after success. The cache
          # is root-owned by the container, so file operations run in it too.
          staging="trivy-db-staging-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          in_cache() {
            docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/cache" "$TRIVY_IMAGE" -ec "$1" sh "$staging"
          }
          # Also drop staging caches abandoned by cancelled runs.
          cleanup_staging() {
            in_cache 'rm -rf "/cache/$1"
              find /cache -maxdepth 1 -name "trivy-db-staging-*" -mmin +120 -exec rm -rf {} \;' || true
          }
          trap cleanup_staging EXIT

          downloaded=false
          for repository in ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-db:2 mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2; do
            for attempt in 1 2; do
            if docker run --rm --network host \
              -e HTTP_PROXY -e HTTPS_PROXY -e NO_PROXY \
              -e http_proxy -e https_proxy -e no_proxy \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
              "$TRIVY_IMAGE" \
              fs --download-db-only --timeout 5m --cache-dir "/root/.cache/trivy/$staging" --db-repository "$repository"; then
              downloaded=true
              break 2
            fi
            sleep "$attempt"
            done
          done
          if [ "$downloaded" = true ]; then
            in_cache 'rm -rf /cache/db.previous
              if [ -d /cache/db ]; then mv /cache/db /cache/db.previous; fi
              mv "/cache/$1/db" /cache/db
              rm -rf /cache/db.previous'
            exit 0
          fi

          updated_at="$(metadata_epoch UpdatedAt)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$updated_at" ]; then
            age_hours=$(( (now - updated_at) / 3600 ))
            if [ "$age_hours" -le "$TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS" ]; then
              echo "::warning title=Trivy DB download failed::Using the cached vulnerability database built ${age_hours}h ago (limit ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h)."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::Cached vulnerability database is ${age_hours}h old, over the ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h fallback limit."
          else
            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::No usable cached vulnerability database."
          fi
          exit 1
      - name: Vulnerabilities (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          # The previous step prepared the database; never re-download here.
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --skip-db-update --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Secrets
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Misconfiguration (HIGH/CRITICAL)
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --checks-bundle-repository ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-checks:2 --scanners misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Emit relay identity
        run: |
          set -eu
          jwt="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=clued-hosted-relay-v1" \
            | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["value"])')"
          echo "::notice title=clued-hosted-relay-v1::$jwt"
